kind: standalone line/point correctness, resident GPU, preparation/software CPU and memory diagnostic
methodology: Identical release source and dependency locks in isolated baseline/candidate targets. Allocator-disabled ABBA twice: four fresh processes/version, one warmup and five samples/case; separate allocator-instrumented builds. CPU uses checked aggregate CLOCK_PROCESS_CPUTIME_ID. No task-owned builds/checks/tests run during timing. Preparation creates fresh Scene/cache, returns owner plus PreparedScene, checks and drops outside timing; canonical Actor source is shared. Software frames reuse one geometry preparation; allocation/rasterization timed; exact within-version image checked outside. GPU upload reuses prepared CPU geometry and initialized per-kind pipelines, times resident buffer/LUT/uniform allocation and upload submission; destruction outside timing. GPU submit times public render encoder/uniform/submit CPU with resident buffers, excluding target/device creation, first shader/pipeline use, GPU completion, readback, validation and destruction. Readback outside each submission sample waits for completion. Upload and submit numbers do not measure GPU execution latency or energy. Baseline lines are uncolored, points absent, and GPU rejects lines; GPU primitive cases run only on candidate and are not speedup comparisons. Surface and plain-line controls explicitly report pixel equivalence. Geometry comprises 256/8192/65536 cells; line segments overlap repeated rows, points occupy repeated 256x256-grid coordinates; frames 128 square, opaque. Selected point/cell scalars use viridis, uncolored controls use flat color. Payload means retained derived CPU bytes for prepare/software, actual uploaded geometry buffers for GPU; canonical source, target, pipeline, LUT, uniforms, metadata and allocator overhead excluded. Allocation bytes include positive realloc growth; they are neither total resized-buffer traffic nor peak/live/RSS/VRAM. Single chunk per GPU primitive kind in these workloads; arithmetic device/chunk bounds separately tested. Host affinity/thermal state uncontrolled. No power, mobile, cross-platform device, whole-application or first-use qualification.
